responsibility: Implements PHI-cycle analysis for the GIMPLE ranger subsystem. It discovers groups of mutually recursive PHI-defined SSA names that have a single initializer and at most one modifier statement, computes a shared nonvarying range for the cycle by iterating range folding and using inferred relations when possible, caches the resulting phi_group objects in a singleton phi_analyzer, and provides initialization/finalization and dump support for this specialized range reasoning over loop-like PHI recurrences.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of the PHI-range pair: it defines the singleton phi-analysis state and the executable logic for discovering PHI groups, computing their ranges, and dumping results, whereas gcc/gimple-range-phi.h provides the class and API declarations used by ranger clients.
